questions: In fully visible middle frames, are exactly three pens visible on the white carrier?
Does each pen show a visible black cap-like part at its lower end?
Does any pen show an exposed pointed writing tip where the black cap-like part should be?
Are the three pens parallel and similarly oriented on the carrier?
Does the carrier move smoothly from LEFT to RIGHT while the pens remain stable relative to it?

question_answers.evidence: In frames 00:05 through 00:09, exactly three pens are clearly visible on the white carrier plate.
The middle and right pens have black caps at the bottom, but the leftmost pen does not.
The leftmost pen clearly shows an exposed pointed writing tip at the bottom, unlike the other two pens which have black caps.
The three pens are arranged in a parallel row and maintain their orientation relative to the carrier throughout the video.
The carrier plate moves smoothly from the left side of the frame to the right side, and the pens remain fixed on it.

parsed.reason: The leftmost pen clearly lacks the black cap-like part seen on the other two pens, exposing a pointed writing tip instead, which indicates a MISSING_CAP anomaly.
